z-m-38-05.title: Haddii aan ku dhufanno laba hawlood oo kordhaya, ma wax-soo-saarku had iyo jeer sidoo kale wuu kordhayaa?
z-m-38-05.topic: Hawlaha kordhaya iyo wax-soo-saarrada: dhisidda tusaalayaal lid ku ah wax-soo-saarrada hawlaha toosan, iyo shuruudaha sheegashadu ku run tahay
z-m-38-05.goal: Tijaabi sheegashada “wax-soo-saarka laba hawlood oo kordhaya waa kordhaya,” dhis tusaalayaal lid ku ah oo kala duwan adigoo hawlo toosan isticmaalaya, oo dooro shuruudaha sheegashadu ku run tahay.
z-m-38-05.material: Waxaa jira laba hawlood f iyo g oo goobtoodu tahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah. “Kordhaya” macnaheedu waa haddii x₁ < x₂, markaas f(x₁) < f(x₂). Seoa wuxuu yiri, “Haddii f iyo g labaduba yihiin hawlo kordhaya, markaas wax-soo-saarka h(x) = f(x)·g(x) sidoo kale waa hawl kordhaysa.” Seoa wuxuu qaatay f(x) = x + 1 iyo g(x) = 2x + 1 wuxuuna xisaabiyey h x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.

z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ku fidisay xaqiiqda ah in saddex qiimood ay kordheen dhammaan aagga. Si shaqo u kordho, waa inay run noqotaa dhammaan x₁<x₂.

z-m-38-01.title: Marka aan balaadhinno aagga, sidee ayaa ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta u guuraan?
z-m-38-01.topic: Ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta howsha laba-jibaaran marka aagga uu is beddelo
z-m-38-01.goal: Marka dhammaadka k ee aagga is beddelo, ku hubi shaxda qiimaha sida meesha ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraantu ka dhacaan (geeska ama dhammaad) u beddelanto, oo dib u sheeg saadaashadaadii koowaad.
z-m-38-01.material: Waa kan howsha laba-jibaaran f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (loo akhriyo: 'x labajibaaran laga jaray 4x lagu daray 3'). Dhig aagga 0 ≤ x ≤ k (k waa tiro dhab ah oo togan), beddel k, oo eeg ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta f aagga ku jira. Seoyeon waxay saadaalisay: “Haddii u dhexeyntu ballaadho, ugu yaraantu way yaraataa ugu badnaantuna way weynaataa.” Shaxdaha qiimaha waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid, tallaabo tallaabo.

z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.a: Farqigu waa 4 marka k = 4 oo keliya, k kale ma ahan
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad hubisay oo keliya in farqigu yahay 4 marka k = 4 mana aadan tijaabin qiimayaasha ku xiga (tusaale 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.b: Farqigu waa 4 marka k = 3 oo keliya, k kale ma ahan
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad hubisay oo keliya in ay ku shaqeyso hal qiime mana aadan tijaabin qiimayaasha hareeraha ah.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.c: Farqigu waa 4 tiro dhab ah k kasta oo ah 4 ama ka badan (ilaa iyo k = 4)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.c: Ma aadan hubin in k = 5, ugu badnaantu tahay 8 ugu yaraantuna tahay −1, sidaas darteed farqigu waa 9.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.d: Farqigu waa 4 tiro dhab ah k kasta oo 2 ilaa 4 ah
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu helay heerka ugu yaraantu ku sii jirto −1 ugu badnaantuna ku sii jirto 3 u dhexeynta.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.explain: 2 ≤ k ≤ 4, ugu yaraantu waa −1 (x = 2) ugu badnaantuna waa 3 (x = 0), sidaas darteed farqigu waa 4. Haddii k < 2, ugu yaraantu waa ka weyn tahay −1, sidaas darteed farqigu waa ka yar yahay 4; haddii k > 4, ugu badnaanta f(k) waa ka weyn tahay 3, sidaas darteed farqigu waa ka weyn yahay 4.

z-m-38-04.prereq.0: H1 ee hawshani waa heer adkaansho oo soo saarista loo meeleeyey oo keliya; macnaheedu maaha in manhajku meelaynayo waxyaabahan dugsiga sare fasalka 1aad. U qaado in shuruudaha hoose horey loo bartay.
z-m-38-04.title: Haddii laba qaacidood labaduba ku habboon yihiin saddexda diiwaan, kee ayaan aamini?
z-m-38-04.topic: Doorashada qaacidada ku habboon xogta (isbarbar dhigga saamiga rogan iyo hawl labajibbaar ah)
z-m-38-04.goal: Isbarbar dhig laba nooc oo qaacidooyin ah oo maraya isla saddexda bar ee xogta, go'aami qaacidada kee ayaa la aaminayaa iyo intee le'eg adigoo cabbir cusub iyo qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda isticmaalaya, oo sheeg kala duwanaanshaha aad ku aamini.
z-m-38-04.material: 12 L oo biyo ah ayaa si siman loogu shubay x dhalooyin isku mid ah (x waa tiro dhan oo togan), qadarka y (L) ee hal dhalo ku jiraana waa la cabbiray. Diiwaannada: 1 dhalo, 12 L; 2 dhalo, 6 L; 3 dhalo, 4 L. Laba saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyey qaacidooyin. Jiwon: y = 12/x (akhri sida: '12 loo qaybiyey x'). Hyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (akhri sida: '2 x labajibbaaran laga jaray 12x ku dar 22'). Biyuhu ma daadanayaan, waxaana si siman loogu qaybiyey dhalooyinka.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Naftaada xisaabinta si aad u hubiso haddii xogta iyo moodelku isu waafaqaan
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Hagaajinta sida adag ee aad wax u rumaysato marka caddayn cusub timaaddo
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Kala saaridda waxa xogta ku habboon iyo waxa xaaladda ku habboon
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Helitaanka qiimayaasha hawsha (gelinta x qaacidada oo xisaabinta)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Akhrinta qaacidooyinka hawsha labajibbaarka ah iyo hawsha saamiga y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Xiriirka (tirada dhalooyinka) × (qadarka hal dhalo ku jira) = wadarka qadarka
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Saddexda diiwaan ee kor ku xusan oo keliya eegista, dooro hadalka ugu habboon.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Geli x = 1, 2, 3 labadaba qaacidooyin oo la barbar dhig diiwaannada shax.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii qaacidada maraysa saddex bar ay tahay mid keliya, mise dhowr ayaa jiri kara.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x waa ka fudud yahay, sidaa darteed diiwaannadan oo keliya way ku filan yihiin si lagu gunaado qaacidada Jiwon inay sax tahay
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad “qaacidada waa fudud tahay” u isticmaashay sida haddii ay caddayn tahay. Fudaydnimadu waxay noqon kartaa sabab lagu rumaysto, laakiin xogta ma go'aamiso.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 wuxuu leeyahay dhammaan isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah sidaa darteed wuu ka sax badan yahay, sidaa darteed qaacidada Hyunwoo waa sax
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad saxnaanta ka raadisay muuqaalka isku-dhufashooyinka. Haddii qaacidadu xogta ku habboon tahay waxaa lagu ogaan karaa adigoo qiimayaal geliya oo keliya.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Labada qaacidoodba waxay ku habboon yihiin saddexda diiwaan, sidaa darteed diiwaannadan oo keliya ma sheegi karaan kee sax ah
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Xukunkani wuxuu aqoonsadaa in marka laba qaacidood isla xogta ku habboon yihiin, xogta oo keliya ma kala saari karto.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Qaacidada maraysa saddex bar waa mid keliya, sidaa darteed mid ka mid ah labada waa inuu leeyahay khalad xisaabeed
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad rumaysatay in qaacidada maraysa saddex bar ay tahay mid keliya. Xataa haddii hawl labajibbaar ah ay marto saddex bar, nooc qaacidad ah oo kale ayaa marsan kara isla baraha.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Gelinta x = 1, 2, 3 waxay siinaysaa 12, 6, 4 labada qaacidoodba, taasoo waafaqaysa diiwaannada. Maadaama laba qaacidood isla xogta ku habboon yihiin, diiwaannadan oo keliya ma kala saari karaan. Si loo go'aamiyo qaacidada kee la aamino, waxaad u baahan tahay aasaas kale, sida cabbir cusub ama qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: Macluumaadka cusub hal-hal ayaa loo muujiyaa. Tallaabo kasta, go'aami sida rumaysadkaaga labada qaacidood u beddelmo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Geli tirada dhalooyinka x ee la muujiyey labada qaacidoodba si aad naftaada u hesho qiimayaasha la sii sheegay, oo la barbar dhig qiimaha la cabbiray.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Marka qiimaha la cabbiray uu ka duwan yahay sii-sheegidda, ka fikir labadaba suurtagalnimada: qaacidada waxay noqon kartaa khalad, ama cabbirku wuu khaldami karaa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Biyaha waxaan u qaybinnay 4 dhalo oo waxaan cabbirnay qadarka hal dhalo ku jira: wuxuu ahaa 3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Marka aad qiimahan la cabbiray la barbar dhigto sii-sheegidda labada qaacidood, maxaad ka gunaanatay labada qaacidood?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Qaacidada Jiwon waxay sii sheegtaa 3 L x = 4, tan Hyunwoo na waxay sii sheegtaa 6 L. 3 L ee la cabbiray waxay waafaqsan tahay qaacidada Jiwon aad bay uga duwan tahay tan Hyunwoo. Waa macquul in si dhakhso ah loo aamino dhinaca Jiwon, waana macquul in mar kale la cabbiro sababtoo ah suurtagalnimada khaladka cabbirka.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Cabbirku wuu khaldami karaa, sidaa darteed mar kale cabbir oo kadibna go'aami
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Kani waa dabeecad taxaddar leh: oo aan u boodin gunaanad hal qiime la cabbiray, laakiin rabta inay hubiso.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Aamin qaacidada Jiwon si ka badan
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu aaminayaa sii-sheegidda ka duwan qiimaha la cabbiray wax yar.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Aamin qaacidada Hyunwoo si ka badan
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Xukunkani ma hubin qiimaha qaacidada Hyunwoo siinayso x = 4.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: 6 dhalo waxay cabbirtay 2 L, 12 dhalo na waxay cabbirtay 1 L. (Ilaa hadda, 5 diiwaan.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Waa maxay hab ku habboon oo lagu sheego rumaysadkaaga qaacidada Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Marka xogtu kordho, rumaysadkaaga qaacidada Jiwon wuu kordhaa. Laakiin 5 diiwaan oo keliya ma dammaanad qaadi karaan x kasta. Haddii ay jirto sabab (qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda), rumaysadkaaga waa la xoojin karaa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Dhammaan 5-ta diiwaan waa sax ahaayeen, sidaa darteed waxaan ku gunaanan karnaa inay sax tahay tiro dhan oo togan x kasta
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Waxaad “diiwaanadu shan jeer sax bay ahaayeen” ku fidisay dhammaan xaaladaha. Qiimayaasha x ee aan la cabbirin weli lama hubin.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Xataa haddii tirada diiwaannada ku habboon ay kordho, rumaysadkayagu gabi ahaanba ma beddelmo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Tani ma tixgeliso in cabbir cusub uu yahay caddayn tilmaamaysa isla jihada.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Rumaysadkayagu wuu kordhay sababtoo ah 5 diiwaan ayaa ku habboonaaday, laakiin sabab gooni ah ayaa weli loo baahan yahay si uu ugu run yahay qiimayaasha x ee aan la cabbirin
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Xukunkani wuxuu yiraahdaa caddayntu waxay xoojisaa rumaysadka, laakiin sabab ayaa loo baahan yahay si loogu guud-ka-dhigo dhammaan xaaladaha.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Haddii aad ku dhufato tirada dhalooyinka qadarka hal dhalo ku jira, had iyo jeer waxaad heshaa wadar 12 L. Taas waa sababtoo ah biyuhu ma daadanayaan oo si siman ayaa loogu qaybiyey dhalooyinka.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Markaad tan ogaato, maxaad ka odhan kartaa qaacidada Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Maadaama x·y = 12, y = 12/x waxay si toos ah uga timaaddaa xaaladda, ma aha diiwaannada. Sidaa darteed waxaan odhan karnaa wuu run yahay tiro dhan oo togan x kasta malo-awaalka “biyuhu ma daadanayaan oo si siman ayaa loo qaybiyey” hoostiisa. Haddii malo-awaalku jabo (haddii biyo daadato), qaacidada sidoo kale way is beddeshaa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Maaha diiwaannada oo keliya laakiin qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda, waxaan odhan karnaa y=12/x tiro dhan oo togan x kasta ilaa biyuhu aysan daadanin oo si siman loo qaybiyey
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Xukunkani wuxuu dejiyaa kala duwanaanshaha rumaysadka isagoo labadan sabab isla isticmaalaya: caddaynta xogta iyo qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Weli waa inaan ku tiirsanaano 5-ta diiwaan oo keliya, qaab-dhismeedka xaaladduna aasaas ma aha
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Waxaad seegtay in xiriirka ka yimaada xaaladda (wax-soo-saarku waa joogto) uu si toos ah u go'aamiyo qaacidada.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Qaacidada Hyunwoo si kadis ah ayay saddexda bar u marta, sidaa darteed qaacidada Jiwon waa khalad
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Qaacidada Hyunwoo oo maraysa saddexda bar macnaheedu maaha qaacidada Jiwon inay khaldan tahay. Qaacidadiisa ma waafaqdo qaab-dhismeedka qiimayaasha x kale.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.reflect: s1 waxaad xukuntay “lama kala saari karo,” qaar na waxay beddeleen ka dib aragtida cabbirka 4-ta dhalo, kuwa kale na waxay ku hayeen “mar kale cabbir.” Sheeg haddii sababta xukunkaaga beddelmay ama sii jirtay ay ahayd qiimaha la cabbiray mise qaab-dhismeedka xaaladda.
